response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile engineer with 14+ years across web, mobile, embedded and high-throughput backend systems, and clear evidence of craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching). However, the resume shows essentially no exposure to the core of this role: experimentation frameworks, A/B testing quality/bias detection, feature flighting, telemetry and metrics infrastructure, or growth measurement. Scope is also mostly team-level product delivery at startups/SMEs rather than principal-level, multi-workstream architecture across an enterprise with globally distributed, multi-region high-availability services. Language stack (TypeScript/Node, DLang) only partially overlaps with the listed core languages, and there is little demonstrated data/statistical analysis aptitude. A strong senior/staff generalist, but a poor match for an IC6 experimentation-systems specialist.
strengths: 14+ years broad full-stack and systems engineering experience, including low-latency services handling millions of req/s
Strong engineering fundamentals: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, test tooling authorship
Demonstrated initiative and mentorship — founded an open-source platform, ran workshops, courses and talks
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging or growth-measurement platform experience
Limited telemetry/metrics infrastructure and statistical/data-analysis evidence
Scope and influence appear team-level at smaller companies, not principal-level cross-org architecture at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Scope below Principal/IC6 cross-org leadership bar
Deep, long-tenured engineering breadth and craftsmanship
